text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...I thought I heard someone call'n
me just
now. Guess I was just imagin'n
things.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But y'know, the Three Goddesses sure
are a trio
of lookers. I wonder if they
were city girls too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Goddesses, if I keep on doing my best,
will I
also b'come a bona fide city girl
someday?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Like they're gonna answer me!
